joints.contact: Joints can only be installed between two directly connected cubes
joints.hopping: So far, the assembled creature can only hop and ram targets like a slime
joints.intro: Install joints so it can turn its head, swing its arms to attack, and walk
joints.order: To install a joint, right-click the moving cube first (such as the upper arm), then the fixed cube (such as the torso)
joints.stats_intro: The finished mimic's base stats depend on factors such as the volume of its body parts
joints.stats_shape: For example, a larger body gives more health, bulkier arms deal more damage, and longer legs increase movement speed
joints.text_6: Legs must touch the ground to work
joints.text_8: Hold Alt while hovering over the Cardboard Box containing your finished mimic to see its stats
joints.title: Installing Joints
joints.types_upper: Use a Neck Joint for the head, Shoulder and Elbow Joints for the upper arms and forearms, and Hip and Knee Joints for the upper and lower legs
placing.capture: Use a Capture Net or Cardboard Box to capture a mimic, then right-click the table to place it
placing.cultivate: First grow a mimic in a Slime Petri Dish. See its Ponder scenes to learn more
placing.intro: Use a Surgical Table to dissect mimics and assemble parts from different donors into a new mimic
placing.irreversible: Placing a mimic on the table turns it into surgical parts. This conversion is irreversible
placing.multiple: Multiple mimics can share the same work surface
placing.redstone: Power any part of the connected work surface to display the creatures' original appearance
placing.surface: Adjacent Surgical Tables connect to form one continuous work surface
placing.title: Placing Donors
recombining.cut: Right-click a connection with Shears to cut the creature apart one cube at a time
recombining.hover: Hold a tool and hover over a cube to see how to use it
recombining.kit: Surgical Tables support many other tools. Craft a Surgical Kit to switch between them quickly
recombining.more_tools: Later chapters cover what the other tools do.
recombining.move: Use a Cardboard Box to pick up and reposition all the connected parts together
recombining.replace: Take the parts you need from other donors, then select the two attachment points one after the other with Super Glue to assemble a new body structure
recombining.text_5: Legs must touch the ground to work
recombining.text_6: Hold a tool and hover over a cube to see how to use it
recombining.text_7: Hold a tool and hover over a cube to see how to use it
recombining.title: Cutting and Reassembling
recombining.tools: Use tools to dissect and reassemble creatures on the table
title: Surgical Table: Assemble Your First Bionic Creature
traits.adjust: Follow the hints to adjust the tissue, its placement, and the joints. Check the result again and repeat until you have the combination of traits you want
traits.dissect: First, cut the Creeper and the Phantom on either side of the table into individual cubes
traits.donors: For example, you can combine the Creeper's Self-Destruct with the Phantom's Winged Flight...
traits.example: Move the cubes you need to the center of the table and reassemble them to combine the Creeper's Self-Destruct with the Phantom's Winged Flight
traits.inspect: Hold a Cardboard Box and hover over a creature on the Surgical Table to see its traits and missing requirements. Gray entries are inactive
traits.intro: Besides changing the creature's appearance and base stats, retained donor tissue can give it unique bionic traits
traits.jei: Look up the Surgical Table's recipes in JEI to see each trait's effect, requirements and donors
traits.joints: Shoulder Joints make both wings count as arms. Without a Neck Joint, head traits are determined by the head tissue in the torso
traits.lookup: You can also look up traits from donor previews, spawn eggs or filled Cardboard Boxes
traits.mind: Disposition and Intelligence are the most basic traits. They affect target selection and combat strategy, respectively
traits.result: The result is a living bomber
traits.rules: Presence traits only need the right tissue. Threshold traits need a minimum proportion of it, and Scaled traits vary in effect with that proportion
traits.scope: Each trait applies to a specific region. Some affect the whole body, while others only work in the relevant body part
traits.text_11: You can also look up traits from donors, spawn eggs, or Cardboard Boxes containing creatures
traits.text_5: Hold a Cardboard Box and hover over a creature on the Surgical Table to see its traits and any unmet requirements
traits.text_6: Presence traits only need the right tissue. Threshold traits need a minimum proportion of it, and Scaled traits vary in effect with that proportion
traits.text_6_2: A gray entry means that trait is inactive
traits.text_8: Disposition and Intelligence are the most basic traits. They affect target selection and combat strategy, respectively
traits.title: Introducing Traits
traits.volume: Tissue proportions are measured within the region where a trait applies. Self-Destruct is a torso trait, so Phantom tissue on the arms has no effect on it
